# telnyx_enterprise_verify_email_confirm (Action)

Confirms an enterprise's contact email with the code Telnyx sent to it.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) The 6-digit code sent to the enterprise account's contact email.
- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.
